title: Add check for IPv6 brackets when address is unresolved

timeline.author: Aayush Atharva

timeline.body:
Motivation:
If IPv6 is unresolved, we add double `[]` to it which leads to a malformed IPv6 address.

Modification:
If unresolved IPv6 already has double brackets `[]` to it then return as it is else add `[]`.

Result:
Fixes #14137
@hyperxpro shouldn't we only do this if its `unresolved` ?

timeline.message: Check for brackets only if the address is unresolved.
